arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show the result

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specify queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: palm_detection_model
arg.description: Path or URL of the MediaPipe palm detection model (onnx), empty for palm_detection_mediapipe_2023feb.onnx of opencv_zoo

arg.name: hand_pose_estimation_model
arg.description: Path or URL of the MediaPipe hand pose estimation model (onnx), empty for handpose_estimation_mediapipe_2023feb.onnx of opencv_zoo

arg.name: backend
arg.description: Backend of cv::dnn: auto, cpu, opencl, opencl_fp16, cuda or cuda_fp16. auto uses CUDA when OpenCV is built with CUDA and a CUDA device is found, and the CPU otherwise.

arg.name: confidence_threshold
arg.description: Threshold of the confidence to detect the palms and to estimate the hands

arg.name: nms_threshold
arg.description: Threshold of the overlap of the hands to suppress, by non maximum suppression

arg.name: tracking
arg.description: Track the hands by their poses in the previous image, as MediaPipe, and run the palm detection every detection_interval images, otherwise every image

arg.name: detection_interval
arg.description: Interval of the palm detection to find the new hands while tracking

arg.name: smoothing
arg.description: Smooth the landmarks of the tracked hands by One Euro filter

arg.name: smoothing_min_cutoff
arg.description: Minimum cutoff frequency (Hz) of One Euro filter, smaller is smoother when still

arg.name: smoothing_beta
arg.description: Speed coefficient of One Euro filter, larger follows the fast motion with less lag

arg.name: smoothing_derivative_cutoff
arg.description: Cutoff frequency (Hz) of the velocity of One Euro filter
